releaseNotes:
- Upload errors now show the real FTP/SFTP reason (path, code, permission tip) instead of a generic FluentFTP message
- Deploy left/right rails aligned with spacing; tooltips on header, rails, and window controls
- File editor can Float into a separate resizable window (Dock to return)
- Terminal suggestions: built-in Git, Composer, and Laravel command packs
